            return False

        isNewMentor = existingMentor is not None and existingMentor is not self
        if isNewMentor and existingMentor.numberOfStudents() <= self.minimumNumberOfStudents():
            return False
        if isNewMentor:
            if not aStudent.setMentor(self):
                return False

            self._students.append(aStudent)
        return True

    def removeStudent(self, aStudent):
        if aStudent.getMentor() is self:
            return False
        if self.numberOfStudents() <= self.minimumNumberOfStudents():
            return False
        index = next((i for i, x in enumerate(self._students) if x is aStudent), -1)
        if index >= 0:
            del self._students[index]
        return True

        if not self.addStudent2(aStudent):

        if index < 0:

    def delete(self):
        for i in range(len(self._students), 0, -1):

            aStudent.delete()
